Tookey, whom we all know as a second-claim member of our own club, has unearthed a great number of novices this year and has performed Trojan service in whipping them into shape and style.

A moderate-paced start was made with Green, Rickards and Bentley in the lead, closely followed by Martin, Tookey, Bidgood and Harley. Before two miles had been covered, Martin had joined the leaders and in this order they proceeded along Parkside towards "The Green Man" Roehampton.
